name: EH3D-NODE-BUNGARD-AUX
stack: C++17 (host-tested core); ESP-IDF 5.5 firmware for the ESP32-S3 with a W5500 wired network port
build: cmake -S tests -B build/host && cmake --build build/host && ctest --test-dir build/host -C Debug
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.5: a node for the drill head of a Bungard CCD machine that measures the height of the table with a laser, reads the speed and the temperature of the spindle, opens a protect output when the spindle is too fast or too hot and shows the camera, all over a wired network behind a token. The rules are in the host-tested core: the settings file with safe defaults, the measure from several laser readings (the odd ones thrown away, a spread that is too large refused), the speed of the spindle from pulses, the temperature with a hysteresis, the protect output and the words of the network. The ESP-IDF firmware is written but has not been built, flashed or run on a board; the drivers of the laser and of the temperature sensors are not written and nothing has been connected to a machine.
